configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Install to $HOME, Release build, no tests.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Install to $HOME, Debug build, tests enabled.

configurePresets.name: hpc
configurePresets.description: Install to /opt/modena, Release build, Fortran wrapper. Override CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX as needed.

configurePresets.name: full
configurePresets.displayName: Full — user install, every wrapper + tests + portal + docs
configurePresets.description: Install to $HOME with all optional components enabled: Fortran, Julia, MATLAB/Octave and R wrappers, the test suite, the web portal, and Doxygen docs. Any component whose toolchain is missing is skipped with a warning rather than failing the configure, so this stays usable on a partially provisioned machine. The build summary reports which wrappers were found; Doxygen is probed after that summary prints, so watch for its warning separately.
